invalid_reason: The fa-retrieval-v1 test split is degenerate by construction: its queries are of the form 'محتوای سند {title} چیست؟' where {title} is synthetic metadata (e.g. 'hr-0') that never appears in the corpus text. Labelled query/document pairs share zero distinctive tokens, so Recall@K is 0.0 for ANY model. This is a dataset artifact, not a model result — see tests/integration/embedding/test_dataset_grounding.py::test_ungrounded_title_query_would_fail_recall_at_5, and note that validate_dataset.py and the integrity suite only ever check the VALIDATION split.
latency_note: Includes embed_query plus the 220-doc similarity scan, so it is not comparable to the val-run figure, which timed embed_query alone.
